name: NASA OSTEM and Pathways internships
reason: The NASA page lists these for college-level students only (undergraduate through graduate; U.S. citizens; age 16 or older). High schoolers are not eligible. Some third-party sites wrongly say otherwise. The real NASA Ames option for high schoolers is GeneLab for High Schools, which is in the main list.

name: Valley Water College Summer Internship Program
reason: For college students who have finished two years of study, or graduate students. Pays $28.27 an hour but excludes high schoolers. Valley Water's Youth Commission (in the main list) is the high school option.

name: JobTrain Young Adult Services (Menlo Park)
reason: Free career training and paid work experience, but the eligibility reported is ages 17 to 24 and out of school. In-school high schoolers generally do not qualify.

name: Cisco High School Externship
reason: Two weeks in July, unpaid, for juniors and seniors with a 3.5 GPA, but only at sites in New York, Austin and Research Triangle Park. No San Jose site. Travel and housing are on the family.

name: San Jose Conservation Corps and Charter School
reason: Serves ages 17.5 to 27 as a re-engagement charter school with paid job training. It is for youth who left or aged out of regular high school, not enrolled high schoolers.

name: Tesla Manufacturing Development Program (Fremont)
reason: For recent high school graduates (paid, with a 10-week Ohlone College certificate). Not for students still in high school. Details come from a search listing, not the Tesla page.

name: Intel 8-week paid summer internship (university sites)
reason: Open to high school students but hosted at universities such as Central State and Clark Atlanta, not in the Bay Area.

name: Genentech Futurelab Scholarship
reason: A college scholarship for seniors at El Camino High and South San Francisco High only. It is not an internship.

name: Youth At Work (youthatwork.org)
reason: Listed on a Fremont Union High School District page but the domain now redirects to a domain-for-sale page. Defunct. Use NOVAworks (408-730-7640) instead.

name: Mountain View Public Library website (mvpl.org)
reason: The domain redirects to a domain-for-sale page. Could not check teen volunteer details.

name: Young Entrepreneurs Academy (YEA!)
reason: Real national program for grades 6 to 12, but the page I read does not name a Silicon Valley chapter. Not confirmed locally.

name: Stanford RISE internship (Office of Science Outreach)
reason: Older articles describe a 7-week paid ($2,500) internship for low-income Bay Area high schoolers, but I could not reach a current program page (oso.stanford.edu did not resolve). Unconfirmed and possibly discontinued.

name: Good Samaritan Hospital San Jose volunteer program
reason: The hospital says it is not taking new volunteer applications because it is at capacity with a long waitlist.

name: Youth Science Institute teen volunteers
reason: The page says YSI is not accepting youth volunteers right now (normally ages 14 to 17). Email volunteer@ysi-ca.org to ask.

name: Google Computer Science Summer Institute (CSSI)
reason: Reported to be for graduating seniors starting college, free, virtual or at some Google offices. The Google page returned unreadable data and I only have third-party reports, so I did not list it. Check the page in late fall.

name: Midpen Open Space District youth crews (Student Conservation Association)
reason: Only 2018 and 2019 press releases describe ages 14 to 19 crews. The current Midpen volunteer page does not list a teen program. Contact Midpen to ask.

name: Kaiser Permanente Santa Clara and San Jose teen volunteer programs
reason: I could not find a current page for these medical centers. Use the KP LAUNCH paid program (in the main list) instead.

name: Santa Clara Valley Medical Center junior volunteers
reason: Site blocked automated reading and I found no teen volunteer page. Unconfirmed.

name: City of Fremont Youth and Family Services
reason: Counseling and family support for ages 0 to 29, not an employment or volunteer program for teens. Fremont Family Resource Center phone: 510-574-2100.

name: Morgan Hill city volunteer opportunities
reason: The only age listed is 16 and up for Preschool Aide. No dedicated teen program found.

name: Second Harvest of Silicon Valley volunteering
reason: The page I read did not state minimum ages for teens. Call 1-800-984-3663 to ask.

name: Silicon Valley Education Foundation volunteering
reason: Volunteer roles are for adults with STEM careers. No teen volunteer role.

name: Techbridge Girls
reason: Real program for girls grades 5 to 12 in Bay Area schools, but I could not confirm a Silicon Valley site or direct teen sign-up.

name: Santa Clara University high school summer programs
reason: Summer Sessions page focuses on undergraduates. A Young Scholars link returned a 404, so no confirmed high school program.
